---
title: "Winter Semester 2024/25"
subtitle: "Part 1: Statistics and Econometrics · MK-068-EN (TM) WS2024/25. Empirical Research Methods"
---

The second run of the programme, and the one the slide sources in the
repository correspond to. Every deck below exists in two forms: the
**interactive slides** rendered from the `.qmd` source, and the **PDF** that was
uploaded to Ilias for the students (the dates are the days the PDF was added to
the repository). Two decks read data that is not in the public repository, so
for those only the PDF is available; see the note at the end.

Inside a deck: `?` shows the keyboard shortcuts, `o` opens the slide overview,
`f` goes full screen, `m` opens the menu, and `e` switches to print view so you
can save the deck as a PDF from your browser.

## Sources

The sources of this cohort are the current state of the repository:
[`materials/`](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/tree/main/materials)
on the `main` branch. The last content change for the cohort is commit
[`f36972a`](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/commit/f36972a)
of 27 November 2024, "Slides completed 2024".

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Two decks are PDF only

**Week 01, Part 2** reads `materials/data/poverty-population.csv` and
**Week 03** reads an SPSS file from the Uganda nutrition project. Both files are
kept out of the public repository (see the `.gitignore`), so the decks cannot be
rendered here. The PDFs above are the versions the students received. Once the
two files are in place locally, the decks render with the rest of the site;
the [README](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/#readme) explains
how.
:::
